about.title: A Little Bit of Our History
about.history_text:
Don Enrique was born in the heart of our city with a simple dream: to create a place where good food, quality craft beer and unforgettable moments merge. Since our humble beginnings, we have dedicated ourselves to perfecting our recipes, from our pizza dough to the selection of hops for our beers.

Each dish we serve and each pint we pour carries a part of our passion and dedication. Our place, designed with a balance between rustic and modern, seeks to be the perfect setting for your meetings, celebrations and chats with friends. More than a bar, we are a family that opens its doors to you.
